params.why: Answers seq 8's open riskiest-assumption by betting that a screen can approximate the agent's ear through self-reported signal: explicit checkbox questions mirror what the agent used to ask aloud (told to move money, bank/police impersonation, pressure to act fast), and only a flagged answer escalates to the irrecoverability warning and the cancel-or-continue choice — unflagged customers pass through with minimal friction, keeping seq 7's no-call completion intact.
